Coram : H.S. BEDI, GYAN SUDHA MISRA
A B Penal Code, 1860: ss. 3048, 498A - Allegation of dowry death against appellant-husband, his brothers, parents and sisters - Allegation that all the accused administered poison C to the victim-deceased which resulted in her death - Trial court held the appellant and his parents guilty, however, - High Court upheld the conviction of appellant and ordered acquittal of his parents - On appeal, held: The evidence with respect to the appellant D was almost identical with that of the six accused who were acquitted of the same charge - Allegation of poisoning was not substantiated as no
Decision Date : 25-08-2011 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1085/2003 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
